owner_authorized_time_window.meaning: owner signed the UserOperation to authorize it only during a specific validUntil/validAfter time window

relayer_holds_signed_userop.meaning: a relayer or observer holds a valid signed UserOperation

suffix_unauthenticated.meaning: the trailing 12-byte validUntil||validAfter suffix of the 77-byte signature is not authenticated by the signer

submitted_before_intended_window.meaning: the same UserOperation is submitted earlier than the owner-intended validAfter start of the authorized time window

assumptions: The relayer needs no on-chain role beyond holding the signed UserOperation.
The owner-intended window is the validUntil/validAfter window the owner signed for; concrete timestamp values are not given.
The submission is of the same UserOperation whose suffix was stripped or rewritten.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete validUntil/validAfter timestamps or numeric window bounds, so the earlier-than-intended ordering is represented only by the report-stated qualitative temporal relation.
Report does not state whether the relayer requires any on-chain permission to submit the modified UserOperation.

limitations: Only the submit_earlier_than_intended impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The temporal ordering is qualitative because the report supplies no concrete timestamp values.
The suffix-stripping/rewriting action and root cause are not encoded as P; they are contextual to the violation.
